title: micro-sam
description: Segment objects in a 2D light-microscopy image from point and box prompts with Segment Anything for Microscopy (vit_t_lm).

segment.title: Segment from prompts
segment.description: Compute micro-sam's image embedding, segment one object per prompt and return the label image and a per-object table.

image.description: One 2D TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG light-microscopy image

prompts.description: JSON array, one entry per object: {"points": [[x, y, 1 or 0], ...], "box": [x0, y0, x1, y1] or null}, in pixels from the top-left; 1 is a positive and 0 a negative point

channel.description: Channel or page the model sees, counting from 1; 0 uses colour (RGB) when the image has it, else the first channel

backend.description: Encoder backend; auto prefers WebGPU and falls back to WebAssembly
